content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I am excited to work together and would like to propose a few small adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms require me to perform additional unspecified services without guaranteed extra compensation. I propose that any additional services requested outside the scope of the agreement shall be subject to a mutually agreed written change order and compensated at agreed rates. - Regarding the relevant clause, intellectual property rights transfer to the client immediately upon creation without being conditional upon full payment. I propose that upon receipt of full payment by the contractor, the client shall obtain exclusive rights in and to all ingredients, product specifications, goodwill, and all other intellectual property rights associated with any products. Thank you for considering these updates, and I look forward to moving forward.
